summary: Iteration 14 - Per-workspace SMTP replacing Microsoft 365 Graph. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass (CRUD, hidden password, partial-update password preservation, /smtp/test 400 on fake host, DELETE, old MS endpoints 404 - /api/mailbox, /api/admin/ms-config, /api/oauth/microsoft/start, forgot-password still 200, campaign send returns mode 'simulation' when SMTP unconfigured with simulated=true deliveries). Frontend: full e2e on /integrations with admin (Yannick + TOTP). Nav renamed to 'E-mail / SMTP'. No 'Connect Microsoft', 'Azure', 'oauth', 'ms-config', or 'mailbox connect' strings on the integrations page. Form saves; after reload host/port/security/username/from_* persist while smtp-password field is EMPTY; partial update (port 587→465, security starttls→ssl) preserves has_password=true. save-smtp-config toggles smtp-status-badge (Geconfigureerd) + nav-check-integrations + enables test-smtp-config + shows delete-smtp-config. Simulation banner (data-testid simulation-banner) shows on dashboard when unconfigured, disappears when configured, returns after delete. Delete resets the form to empty.

test_results.backend_pytest_parallel_note: Under xdist -n 2 the send-simulation test can race with a parallel CRUD test that saves SMTP on the same workspace, causing a false 'mode=smtp'. Serial run (-n 1) is deterministic. Consider adding a dedicated throwaway workspace per class or a lock to isolate.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:850 accepts 'tls' as a valid security value but the send path (send_newsletter_via_smtp / smtp_test_connection in email_util.py) only branches on starttls/ssl/none. If 'tls' is chosen the UI select only exposes starttls/ssl/none so this isn't reachable from the UI, but the API accepts it; consider aligning the whitelist to remove 'tls' or handle it explicitly.

_run_send catches broad Exception per contact but does not short-circuit obviously fatal SMTP errors (bad host, auth failure) - each recipient will individually attempt to connect and each incur the full TCP timeout. For a bad host with many recipients this multiplies the timeout. Consider a single pre-flight smtp_test_connection before the loop and abort with a summary failure if it fails.

Integrations.js relies on cfg.configured to enable 'Verbinding testen' but does not require save-first; if the user changes host/port after save without saving again, the test button will test the SAVED config, not the currently-edited form. Consider disabling it whenever the form is dirty, or auto-save before testing.
AppLayout.js still fetches setupOk flags once on mount ([] deps) - workspace switch without page reload leaves the checkmark stale (same finding as iter13).
server.py:864 returns {ok:true, configured:true} but does not re-validate that host/from_email are non-empty (Pydantic validates via SmtpConfigInput, host is EmailStr for from_email; ok). Fine.

TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY is stored in backend/.env in plaintext (expected in dev). Ensure it's rotated separately in production and documented; loss will make all saved SMTP passwords unrecoverable (correct behavior).
